name: Employee Self Service ${{AGENT_VERSION}}
description: Employee Self Service with Microsoft Copilot using MCP and MCP Apps for Workday, ServiceNow, Jira and Salesforce

disclaimer.text: This agent is version ${{AGENT_VERSION}}. It is good but it does not replace common sense and good judgement.

conversation_starters.title: Show My Org Chart
conversation_starters.text: Show my Workday org chart and summarize my manager, team structure, and direct reports.

conversation_starters.title: My Team Right Now
conversation_starters.text: Give me a snapshot of my team: who's out, what's waiting in my Workday inbox, and the three things I should act on first.

conversation_starters.title: Plan Time Off
conversation_starters.text: I'd like to take next Friday off. Check my balance and who on my team is out, then set up the request for me to confirm.

conversation_starters.title: Review My Workday Inbox
conversation_starters.text: Show my Workday inbox tasks and highlight the approvals and anything that is overdue.

conversation_starters.title: Fix An IT Problem
conversation_starters.text: I'm locked out of my laptop after too many password attempts. Help me get back in, and raise a ticket if that doesn't work.

conversation_starters.title: Get A New Laptop
conversation_starters.text: I'm a developer and need a new laptop. Recommend the right one from the ServiceNow catalog and open the order form.

conversation_starters.title: Trace Hardware Requests
conversation_starters.text: Trace our ServiceNow hardware requests through Coupa and tell me where each one is stuck and who needs to act.

conversation_starters.title: Track Hardware Orders
conversation_starters.text: Show the Coupa IT hardware order list for ServiceNow-originated requests and highlight delayed, partially received, and high-value purchase orders.

conversation_starters.title: Procurement Manager View
conversation_starters.text: Open the Coupa category manager dashboard for IT hardware and summarize spend, open order value, delivery risk, demand, and supplier performance.

conversation_starters.title: Supplier Scorecard
conversation_starters.text: Score our IT hardware suppliers on delivery, quality, lead time and risk, and tell me which contracts need attention.

conversation_starters.title: Demand And Stock
conversation_starters.text: Show Coupa item demand and stock coverage for phones, laptops, monitors, docks, and accessories, then identify the items most at risk.

conversation_starters.title: Check Supplier Invoices
conversation_starters.text: Run a three-way match on our Coupa invoices and prepare a rejection for any that bill more than we received.
